item.content:encoded:
My first +1 on the site, just finished all the 001 proposals and this is still my favourite. Yes, the cliches and tropes may have been a little excessive from time to time, but rather than using them as filler you were able to nail their application and used them to keep the story engaging and tense the whole way through. Despite its length, at no point was I bored or wanted to stop reading.

My only major criticism is in regards to the first three parts - they were well written and interesting on their own, but were only loosely related to The Way It Ends. The references to the first three parts felt more like "easter eggs" than connections that were necessary to the overall plot. I could have skipped to part four and would have mostly understood it in full.

Otherwise, the rest was wonderful and definitely worth the effort. I really loved how much depth the characters had, which also helped in highlighting the differences between the Foundation and the Insurgency. Really looking forward to reading your other works.

item.title: Connections between articles?
item.content:encoded:
I very much thoroughly enjoyed this! Question though:

+ Spoilers n such
- I don't really get the connection

The idea that this as a whole is one big proposal makes me confused about how the articles all relate, especially with the broken god one. Part 1 covers the children who play a role (of moderate importance) in part 4, and part 3 has the same theme of "The O5's/the foundation must be destroyed to save the world from the anomalous".

What doesn't quite fit at all to me is part 2. The broken god doesn't appear anywhere else in the entire proposal (unless I missed a subtle reference or something), and doesn't contribute to the cycle or overarching story idea in any way… It's not a bad proposal on its own, it's like the scarlet king proposal where the SCP takes the 001 slot not because of it's fundamental connections to anomalies or the foundation, but because of its nature as a very dangerous SCP (or something like that).

It just doesn't seem to offer anything to the whole ouroboros concept or the rest of the narrative, and would probably be better as its own standalone 001 proposal or something.

item.content:encoded:
Spoilers for djkaktus's Proposal III
– hide block

In The Way It Ends, we learn:

  • Aaron was the original O5-1.
  • Aaron made a deal with Death to bring Sophia back to life. Sophia was the original O5-2.
  • Vince/Anthony wanted revenge for Aaron's defection.

The Epilogue reveals:

  • Calvin is the new O5-1.
  • Calvin made a deal with Death to bring Olivia back to life. Olivia is now O5-2.
  • Adam wants revenge for Calvin's defection.

We can assume:

  • Olivia (like Sophia) will give the reborn Insurgency a weapon which can destroy the Overseers.
  • Adam (like Vince) will take part in the effort to kill the new O5s.
  • The reborn Insurgency (like their predecessors) will successfully kill the new Overseers, but they will not be able to neutralize the Administrator.
  • The Insurgent with the strongest convictions (like Calvin) will become the new O5-1.

djkaktus notes in this comment:

The only difference [between Aaron and Calvin] is that instead of creating the more hardened but moderating influence of Vince, Calvin creates the radicalizing influence of Adam.

Implying that Adam's convictions may actually be stronger than Vince's.

What does the Broke God call O5-1?

Heyyyyyy Adam, it's me, Mike.

item.title: The Cycle
item.content:encoded:
And following our will and wind
We may just go where no one's been.
We'll ride the spiral to the end
And may just go where no one's been.
Tool - Lateralus

This is four and a half years of work that I can finally tie into one neat little package. Each of these entries are canon with each other, and each builds off of those that came before it.

This would not have been possible without a number of people, namely my collaborator TwistedGears, my good friends ARD, Hippo, Jekeled, Joreth, Shaggy, Kirby, and so many others who either put eyes on or gave contributions to these entries during their conceptions.

I know I said this was a three part deal at the beginning of The Way It Ends, but I lied. It felt much better to me to bring it all together and call it a done deal.

Thanks again to everyone. I love this place, and I love all of you.
